posts.author: Stereofan
posts.content_md:
Aside from wavelength and wattage what should be looked for in a laser?

Tem00 or 01 (what's the diff?) with no mode-hopping, I'd guess and coherence length and polarization contrast (what does the ratio mean?), too. Anything else?

posts.author: Colin Kaminski
posts.content_md: Coherence length over 6 inches, better is single Longitudinal Mode. SLM. TEM00 only. 100 to 1 polarization or better. If you just wnat an easy laser to play with for not much money get the 5 mw laser from integraf.

posts.author: floh
posts.content_md:
For a beginner it will be the best to get a small HeNe. Plug-in and be happy. 

Power around 5-10mW is ok, TEM00 is required. Linear polarization is good but not really neccessary. I have done my first steps without it and it works.

Some holographers use the small HeNe from the philips video disc player that was popular in the 1980's.
